Method of Attack: Renames encrypted files and appends .FOX extension
Exhaustively closes all open file handles before encryption
Communicates frequently with Command & Control server for status updates
Installed manually after brute forcing Remote Desktop Services passwords
Drops batch files to remove file attributes, change permissions, take ownership, and close handles using Handle.exe
Creates ransom note #FOX_README#.rtf with attacker contact emails
Changes desktop wallpaper to ransom note
Registers scheduled task DSHCA to run cleanup batch file with admin privileges
Deletes shadow volume copies, disables recovery startup, and removes itself
Impacted Systems: Computers running Remote Desktop Services connected to the Internet
Attack Vector: Brute force attack on Remote Desktop Services (RDP) to gain access
Indicators of Compromise: File extension .FOX appended to encrypted files
Batch and VBS files in %AppData% folder
